## Model File Preview (MP)

The 3D model family's renderer, and the one with the most gates — because WebGL is the most expensive thing any preview can do.

### Three.js from a CDN, at live render only

Loaded from esm.sh **only at live client render time** — the sanctioned Boxel pattern for external libraries (the loader resolves `https://` specifiers).

### Two gates keep WebGL off the paths where it must not run

**PRERENDER.** Server-side rendering — indexing and prerender — never boots WebGL and never fetches the CDN engine. `isLiveRender()` is the deterministic gate, and the **static cube is the prerender representation**. This is not a fallback; it is the correct answer on that path.

**VIEWPORT.** The viewer boots only while on-screen and **disposes its context when scrolled off**, re-booting on re-entry. Without this, a strip of embedded models would hold a dozen live GL contexts at once and the browser would start dropping the oldest.

### Fitted never boots at all

A collection cell that a grid can show dozens of at once shows the static cube, full stop. Not a smaller viewer — no context.

### The family it serves

`StlDef`, `ThreeMfDef`, `GltfDef`, `GlbDef` all sit under `ThreeDModelDef`, which declares this as its `previewComponent`. Their facts land on the shared `model3d` field; the fitted hero fact reads `model3d.triangles`.


Projected into the four format shells by `FilePreviewStage`, which owns the loading, failure and staleness panes — this component draws content only.

cardInfo.summary: Live WebGL orbit viewer behind two gates — never on prerender, never in a fitted cell, disposed when off-screen.
